def convert_type(fmt_spec, converter):
    fmt = fmt_spec[1] if fmt_spec else ''
    if fmt == '':
        return converter
    flag = ''
    field_name = ''
    modifier = ''
    width = ''
    if fmt.startswith('!'):
        flag += fmt[0]
        fmt = fmt[1:]
    if fmt and fmt[0] in ('-', '+', '~', '!', '.', ':'):
        # ... handle flags
        pass
    
    if fmt.startswith('~'):
        flag += '~'
        fmt = fmt[1:]
    
    while fmt and fmt[0] not in ('-', '+', '~', '!', '.', ':') and fmt[0].isalpha():
        field_name += fmt[0]
        fmt = fmt[1:]
    
    if fmt.startswith('.'):
        fmt = fmt[1:]
        while fmt and fmt[0].isdigit():
            width += fmt[0]
            fmt = fmt[1:]
    
    # Now build regex based on formatter type
    type_map = {
        's': r'\S+',
        'S': r'\s+',
        'w': r'\w+',
        'W': r'\W+',
        'd': r'[-+ ]?\d+|[-+ ]?0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+|[-+ ]?0[bB][01]+|[-+ ]?0[oO][0-7]+',
        'D': r'\D+',
        'f': r'[-+ ]?(?:\d{1,3}(?:[,_]?\d{3})*|\d*)\.\d+',
        'e': r'[-+ ]?(?:\d{1,3}(?:[,_]?\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?|\d*(?:\.\d+)?)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)|nan|NAN|[-+]?inf|[+-]?Inf|[+-]?INF',
        'g': r'(?:[-+ ]?(?:\d{1,3}(?:[,_]?\d{3})*|\d*)(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?|nan|NAN|[-+]?inf|[+-]?Inf|[+-]?INF)',
        'b': r'[-+ ]?0[bB][01]+',
        'o': r'[-+ ]?0[oO][0-7]+',
        'x': r'[-+ ]?0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+',
        'n': r'[-+ ]?\d{1,3}(?:[,.]\d{3})*',
    }
    
    if type_map.get(fmt):
        regex = type_map[fmt]
        return f'({regex})'
    return f'({converter})'
